title: SEC4: pool uses close+reopen, not RESET; explain why
description: CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_RESET is defined (line 152) but never called. The pool always closes the used fd and opens a fresh one in crypto2dev_pool_release(). No comment explains why RESET is not used. The RESET ioctl resets operation state but preserves the key binding on an fd. A future maintainer who 'optimises' pool release to use RESET instead of close+reopen would get fds that appear clean but carry stale key associations, silently producing wrong results for subsequent operations that rely on inline key setup via CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_INIT. Add a comment in crypto2dev_pool_release() explaining that close+reopen (not RESET) is required because each operation sets its own key via INIT, and RESET would preserve key state from the previous operation.
